subject: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Team —

Quick background: SigmaHealth (procurement@sigmahealth.com) is on final PO approval but legal has flagged the absence of a signed SOC 2 Type II report for the audit window they require. Our Type II is still in progress (audit firm engaged; fieldwork completed June). The customer needs either the completed SOC 2 Type II or a signed bridge letter that confirms: audit period, that Type II is in progress, and whether Private/Dedicated deployments are covered. They want this within 48 hours to hit their procurement deadline (finance close next week).

Ask: can Security/Compliance produce a short bridge letter (1 page) and evidence index we can send today? If we can’t get a signed bridge, they may push PO to next quarter and we lose the expansion. Attaching the evidence index draft I started and the auditor cover note we received.

Attachments: evidence-index-2026.csv, soc2-inprogress-cover.pdf

I’m standing by to escalate legal/finance if you need signatures.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Laura — thanks for the heads up. This is time-sensitive but doable if we prioritize. Neha, please triage and confirm whether the auditor (BrightAudit) can provide a formal statement or if we need to issue a Redwood-signed bridge letter.

Evelyn — can you draft a concise bridge letter (template below) that states: audit firm engaged (BrightAudit), audit period (Jun 1, 2025 — Jun 30, 2026), status (fieldwork complete, report pending final review), and scope (Hosted + Dedicated + Private deployments included where customer has signed a BAA). We’ll need Markus to clear legal language and sign-off.

If we can get a draft within 3 hours I will loop in Finance to confirm any credit/reverse terms the customer requests.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Quick update: I reached BrightAudit (audits@brightaudit.com). They confirmed: fieldwork completed 07/15/2026, final report target 09/01/2026 pending reviewer sign-off. They can issue a "confirmation letter" on firm letterhead stating status but cannot issue a final Type II earlier than their QA. That means we can provide either their confirmation or our bridge letter signed by Redwood + attestation language.

Evelyn — recommend we prepare:
- Redwood Bridge Letter (1 page) — confirms audit firm, audit period, status, scope, and contact for auditor.
- Evidence index (CSV) listing artifacts the customer will request (SOC controls evidence pointers).

Markus — once we have the bridge letter text please review for attestation wording (no admissions, factual status only). I can coordinate with BrightAudit if SigmaHealth wants direct confirmation.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Attaching draft bridge letter (redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-draft.pdf) — language kept factual per Neha's guidance. Draft includes:
- Audit firm and contact: BrightAudit (audits@brightaudit.com)
- Audit period: June 1, 2025 — June 30, 2026
- Status: fieldwork completed 07/15/2026; final report pending internal QA with expected delivery 09/01/2026
- Scope: service categories covered; explicit callout that Dedicated & Private deployments are included subject to BAA/contractual controls

I also attached a cleaned evidence-index ready for customer consumption.

Markus — requesting legal review + single-signature approval. If approved, Laura can send the DocuSign link to SigmaHealth.

Evelyn Hart
Security Operations Manager
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: j.sanders@sigmahealth.com, procurement@sigmahealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Jordan / SigmaHealth team — thanks for the quick review call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is Redwood's draft bridge letter and an evidence-index you can reference. Highlights: audit period Jun 1, 2025 — Jun 30, 2026; BrightAudit fieldwork complete; final report expected by 09/01/2026. The bridge letter affirms that our hosting modes (Hosted, Dedicated) and Private deployments are in scope; deployment-specific BAAs are honored where in place.

We included a DocuSign link for signature on the bridge letter to formalize the statement and accelerate procurement: https://www.docusign.com/drive/bridge-letter-REDWOOD-98765

Please confirm if this addresses procurement's checklist or if you need BrightAudit to send a confirmation directly — we can coordinate that as well.

Thanks — hoping we can get the PO across the finish line this week.

—
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Sanders <j.sanders@sigmahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sigmahealth.com, audits@brightaudit.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A couple quick clarifications before we accept and route to legal: 1) Please confirm that the bridge letter explicitly states the audit period (you have it) and that Dedicated environments used by SigmaHealth are included (you mentioned this — need explicit sentence). 2) Will the final Type II include Private/on-prem connectors or are those out of scope? 3) If Redwood provides the bridge letter, can BrightAudit also send a short confirmation to SigmaHealth procurement stating status?

If those points are answered, we can sign the bridge letter and move the PO to finance.

Jordan Sanders
Procurement Lead, SigmaHealth
procurement@sigmahealth.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Sanders <j.sanders@sigmahealth.com>, procurement@sigmahealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, audits@brightaudit.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 last-mile: bridge letter needed to close SigmaHealth PO

Jordan — appreciate the questions. Short answers: 1) Yes — we will add an explicit sentence in the bridge letter: "Redwood's SOC 2 Type II engagement includes Hosted and Dedicated service offerings used by SigmaHealth; controls over Private/on-prem connectors are evaluated and included where a BAA is in place." 2) The final Type II (expected 09/01/2026) will include control coverage for Private connectors to the extent those deployments were in scope during fieldwork — if you need a scope addendum we can confirm specific connectors. 3) BrightAudit has agreed to provide a one-paragraph confirmation of status to SigmaHealth procurement if you request it; I have CC'd audits@brightaudit.com to coordinate.

Next steps: Evelyn will refresh the bridge letter with the explicit sentence and Markus will provide legal sign-off. We’ll send the DocuSign link once signed. If SigmaHealth wants direct contact from BrightAudit, please reply-all and we’ll make the introduction.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Compliance
